card.name: Digits inside long numbers
card.fires_on: Single digits or decimal points partway through a multi-digit number, such as a decimal percentage, ISBN, phone number, date or sequence ID. The number is not yet finished.

modes.label: Digit inside an ID or code
modes.description: A middle digit within an ISBN, phone number, date or sequence code.

modes.label: Stray sentence start
modes.description: An occasional sentence-initial word, with no link to the number pattern.
